subject: general
question: In which country were the 22ⁿd Commonwealth Games held?
solution:
The correct answer is** '__England__'. ​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 2022 Commonwealth Games are known as Birmingham 2022.**
 
• An international multi-sport event for members of the **Commonwealth of Nations took place in Birmingham, England** from 28 July to 8 August 2022.
 
• Birmingham was announced as the host on 21 December 2017.
 
• In this, England hosted the Commonwealth Games for the third time after London in 1934 and Manchester in 2002.
 
• London and Manchester hosted the 7th Games in the United Kingdom after Cardiff in 1958, Edinburgh in 1970 and 1986, and Glasgow in 2014.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The Indian contingent won a total of 61 medals at the 2022 Commonwealth Games in Birmingham, out of which 22 were gold, 16 silver, and 23 bronze.
 
 
• With this, India ranked fourth in this table.
 
 
 
• Australia topped the CWG2022 with 178 medals.
 
• The same was followed by England in second place and Canada in third place.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The event was discontinued in **1974 after its 1962** debut.
 
• The country that was holding the Commonwealth Games for athletes with physical limitations hosted the games. Australia, Jamaica, Scotland, and New Zealand were the nations that held the **Commonwealth Paraplegic Games in 1962, 1966, 1970, and 1974.**
 
• The Games, which are supported by the** fundamental ideals of humanity, equality, and destiny**, seek to bring the Commonwealth family closer together through a spectacular festival of sport.
